initial_screen_assessments.initial_screen_basis: Traceable exact APN in Cochise with inherited marketed offering, owner record and electricity-intensive use hypothesis. Attributable SSVEC/process and substation leads exist as provisional signals. No supported incurable fatality established; a precise public-record/geometry test is inexpensive and decisive.
initial_screen_assessments.hypothesis_scope: Low-water industrial/data-center research hypothesis; buyer requirements unvalidated.
initial_screen_assessments.alternate_use_hypothesis: Rural agricultural/open-land or other existing lawful use, subject to actual zoning/access; no verified value floor.
initial_screen_assessments.next_test: Resolve full legal APN geometry versus marketed 90/103/13-acre portions, retrieve recorded N Aacco Trail instrument, then map corridor and largest contiguous usable scenario.
reasons_against: Assessor 115.45 versus prior GIS 106.92 versus marketing acreage conflict.
Road/public easement width, alignment and legal status unresolved.
Rail/I-10 location can reduce usable area and usable access.
No parcel/load utility evidence, buyer mandate, control terms, water yield or current code conclusion.
initial_screen_assessments.map_policy: Only inherited locator may be shown with its precision caveat; geometry remains null until sourced. Priority does not authorize invented polygon.
